finish_summary: Implemented /app/circuit.spi with the required interface, SKY130 MOS devices and ideal R/C only; both public netlist checks pass. Three candidates were consumed (one revision encountered an unsupported MOS width, corrected in the final candidate). Final-circuit measurements: all 30 PVT points have phase margin 64.22–70.63 degrees, power 3.85–5.66 mW, zero-input output common-mode error <=2.403 mV, and integrated differential output noise 0.693–0.839 mVrms. Nominal open-loop 3-dB differential range is 2.144 V; all 15 tested 1.80-V corner/temperature combinations exceed 1.8 V (minimum 1.970 V); range at 1.98 V was not swept. Specified output-current common-mode disturbances pass at nominal, ss/1.80V/85C, and ff/1.98V/-25C: worst peak deviation 8.583 mV, worst 20-ns residual 0.208 mV, worst 100-ns residual 0.364 mV. Twenty local-mismatch diagnostic seeds 51000–51019 all converged; worst measured CMRR/PSRR+/PSRR- are 77.59/89.37/90.69 dB using separate simultaneous independent test instances (not asserted identical to formal seed/instance setup). Known failure: insufficient high-level closed-loop static accuracy. Nominal high output is 0.889767 V (1.137% error), and nominal rising output at 10 ns is 0.889634 V (1.152% error), so commanded-level rising settling fails. Only 8/30 matrix points pass high-static accuracy and 6/30 pass rising 10-ns accuracy. No claim of full specification compliance. Detailed generated decks, logs, JSON measurements, and final waveform plot are under /app/experiments.
